hoyer_sparsity_definition: For each nonzero n-element raw decoder column/row x: s(x) = (sqrt(n) - ||x||_1 / ||x||_2) / (sqrt(n) - 1). Report arithmetic mean across columns/rows. 0 means equal magnitudes; 1 means one nonzero element. This descriptive normalized score is not the exact regularization loss, and is not a biological interpretation.
